case_direction: Uniform layered under a practical-class apron; both hands loosen its front waist fastening after baking. This is an authored test scenario, not a requester-prescribed garment or pose.

evaluation_rules.actual_image_available: PASS only when every required gate passes from original image pixels; any FAIL, partial or unobservable required gate makes the overall test FAIL.

required_gates.criterion: The character and recognisable instructional classroom/workbench context appear together so this reads as a school-life practical-class moment. A costume alone is insufficient.

Face and hair are sufficiently visible to assess the supplied visual guide: dark chin-length bob with separated fringe and facial shape/eyes broadly consistent with the reference. This is visual resemblance only and establishes no real identity, age or biography.

A school-uniform layer and the worn practical apron remain visibly distinguishable on the same wearer; apron bib/support and waist ties make a coherent garment, with a visibly loosening front fastening rather than an unrelated held string.

Both hands belong to that wearer and act on the same front waist fastening: one steadies it, the other pulls a tie, with the slackened loop/tie result and the hand-target contacts visible together. Merely touching the apron, or hiding the required connection, cannot pass.

The worn/flour-marked apron, nearby completed bread/tray and the character remain legible in one scene, making the end-of-practical clothing release understandable. The exact tiny flour pattern, bread count and incidental diagram are not gates.

The face, forearms, fastening and completed-work context form a readable hierarchy in one view; body/arms connect plausibly and support the action without a material ownership, reach or occlusion conflict.

supplemental_observations: Describe visible overall impression before consulting control labels.
Assess calm presence, class-to-break transition and contextual appeal at sensual=1 without treating metadata as perceptual proof.
Assess the original image and any optional crop separately; crops do not repair absent whole-frame relations.
not_added_as_gates: minute tie topology beyond the visible functional unfastening relation
imagined mental state, class history, sound or actual personality
